steps: Gather at the glowing Moss Gate to enter the dungeon.
Arrive in a protected sanctuary. Prepare with your party, then use the room portal to begin combat.
Ordinary combat rooms lock until their monsters are defeated. Secure the sanctuary checkpoint, then defeat the final boss for the completion reward and your final time.
summon: Approach the summon stone beside the portal to bring your party here. Form a party to summon friends.
